stem: What happens next in this passage after “The teacher explained digital footprints.”?
options: After the change, there were fewer comments, but more thoughtful ones.
A museum became crowded after a popular online video recommended it.
A singer posted an angry message online after reading a rude comment.
Online actions can remain long after feelings change.
